gitCommit.subject: fix(canvas): read name from store at save-execution time to prevent stale closure
gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): read name from store at save-execution time to prevent stale closure

The auto-save hook captured `name` from the Zustand store at render time
via a React selector. When a debounced save fired after a rename, the
closure-captured old name ("Untitled Canvas") would overwrite the renamed
value in the database via updateCanvasDraft.

Fix: read `name` from `useCanvasStore.getState()` inside the mutation
function, consistent with how `canvasObjects` was already handled.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
